description: Get tasks in a specific List with rich filtering — by status, assignees, tags, and due/created/updated date ranges — plus ordering, subtasks and custom-field filters. Paginated. Use when you know which List the tasks live in.

archived.description: If true, include archived tasks. Defaults to false.

assignees.description: Only return tasks assigned to any of these user ids.

field_id.description: Custom field id to filter on.

date_created_gt.description: Only tasks created AFTER this date.

date_created_lt.description: Only tasks created BEFORE this date.

date_updated_gt.description: Only tasks updated AFTER this date.

date_updated_lt.description: Only tasks updated BEFORE this date.

due_date_gt.description: Only tasks due AFTER this date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

due_date_lt.description: Only tasks due BEFORE this date.

include_closed.description: If true, also include closed/done tasks.

list_id.description: ID of the List to read tasks from.

page.description: 0-based page number for pagination. Defaults to 0.

reverse.description: If true, reverse the sort order (descending).

statuses.description: Only return tasks whose status name is in this list.

subtasks.description: If true, include subtasks in the results.

tags.description: Only return tasks that have all of these tag names.

name: get_tasks
